closures.assumption: Every kilogram of pack delivered to the customer eventually enters disassembly, per the CFB-EV cradle-to-grave boundary (§4).
closures.title: End-of-life closure
closures.why: The ProductSystem declares AL_BatteryDisassembly, AL_BatteryCellTreatment and AL_MetalTreatment in the EndOfLife stage, but no exchange in the graph sends the pack to disassembly — the boundary between the manufacturer's DPP and the recycler's dataset is not wired up.

closures.assumption: One brazed cooling plate per 165 kg battery pack (the pack mass in Crenna et al. 2021), i.e. 1/165 of a brazing service per kg of pack. The brazing dataset is denominated in batches of 70 items.
closures.title: Brazing service closure
closures.why: The ProductSystem declares AL_BrazingService, and the paper describes the brazing of the cooling plate as an input to battery production, but no activity in the graph consumes ft:BrazingServiceForBatteryCase.

data_quality.note: PEF requires the DQR to reflect the processes that actually drive the result. This weights each dataset's declared DQR by its share of the climate-change total, so a poor-quality dataset only matters in proportion to what it contributes. Datasets above 5% of the total are flagged 'most relevant'.

headline.pack_mass_note: Pack mass from Crenna et al. (2021) as cited in the case study; used only to restate the result in familiar units.
headline.uncertainty_note: The narrow band combines the proxy-factor uncertainties in quadrature, which assumes they are independent. The worst case adds them linearly, which is what applies if the factor pack is systematically biased in one direction. The true uncertainty sits between the two.

method.engine: PEFDPP graph solve (sequential Leontief over act:inputOf / act:outputOf)
method.honesty_note: The foreground inventory, its linkages, the geographies, the CFF parameters and the data-quality scores are all read from the RDF graph.
